recipe.hardware: 2x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition
recipe.topology: exclusive TP=2 over PCIe without NVLink under WSL2
recipe.quantization: NVIDIA ModelOpt NVFP4 W4A4 routed experts; BF16 attention, GDN, QSA, shared experts, vision, and MTP; FP8 PLE tables dequantized to BF16 at load
recipe.compatibility_lane: portable QSA sparse decode plus NCCL logits fallback

four_k_c2_queue_diagnostic.interpretation: requests completed behind the configured one-running-request scheduler; c2 is not the promoted admission contract

retained_failures_and_fixes: SM120 WSL2 symmetric-memory logits initialization failed before the exact NCCL fallback was selected.
The pinned sparse-attention FA4 CuTe path failed MLIR compilation on SM120; the qualified lane uses SGLang's device-agnostic QSA sparse decoder.
The first long-tool generator undershot 100000 measured prompt tokens; a calibrated 125000-target rerun passed at 105756 measured tokens.
Router admission originally rejected an exact upstream context contract and the Responses adapter rejected a bounded thinking control; both product defects were fixed and regression-tested.
Hermes credential drift and Pi's missing Anvil provider/environment-key reference were repaired, then all three real Mini clients passed without fallback.

publication.sanitization: No credentials, addresses, GPU UUIDs, machine-local paths, or raw client configuration are included.
